method: Same feature-enabled binary, opt-in enable_native at compile time versus unchanged interpreter; seven warmed 300 ms samples per group in both orders. Full validation/capture and result consumption timed, no serialization. No builds/tests/differentials overlap timed runs. Rust controls validate completely but specialize fixture layout.
commands: JX_DIFFERENTIAL_JIT=1 node scripts/check-*.cjs /private/tmp/jx-jsonata-reference target/release/jx (each script separately)
python3 benchmarks/m24/measure.py M25_BINARY FEATURE_OFF_BINARY benchmarks/m26/controls.json benchmarks/m26/controls (repeat --reverse)
limitations: Only Apple M4/aarch64 measured; other hosts lack benchmark evidence.
Native scalar programs cannot return multiple constructor-member registers; lookup/remainder/effects stay interpreted.
Input acquisition may inspect pure untaken-branch fields; guard/shape failure retries the interpreter without output.
Requested bytes and live Rust allocations measured; executable mappings are page-rounded and not included in allocator counters. No RSS or latency distribution claim.
Cold process initialization reported separately from warmed compilation. Sub-percent scan-control amortization is noise and is not a practical gain claim.
initial-* and paired-* predate the final 32-row and varied-branch benchmark additions; native engine semantics are unchanged. Primary final pairs use identical final binary/source.

artifacts.final-paired-*, final-reverse-*: Final engine and benchmark definitions; same binary in both modes and both orders.
artifacts.profile-* / profiles.json: Warmed full sample call trees; anonymous executable code classified separately, approximate self attribution.
artifacts.memory.csv: Eight warmed installations/clones/final drops, no outstanding live heap bytes after final drop.
artifacts.controls-*: M25 versus feature-off M26, unchanged workloads and allocation instrumentation.
